record.reason: 要旨: As language models become more capable, long-term collaboration in learning, reasoning, and decision-making calls for a deeper understanding of the people they serve. Yet training such human-aware language models faces a fundamental supervision gap because current datasets for LLM assistant training contain few if any。要旨上の主題は対象契約のLLM inference/serving効率、推論時圧縮に該当しない。
record.title: Mind2Dialogue: Training Human-Aware Language Models by Simulating User Mental States
